name: Dissipation cuts Fleshcraft's cooldown and Sated's duration by 60 s (#608)
contract: Dissipation 680730 effect 0 is aura 107 with MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -60001 + DieSides 1 = -60000 ms, over EffectSpellClassMask (8388608, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 23 = Fleshcraft 801952, whose RecoveryTime is 300000, so it becomes 240000. Effect 1 is aura 107 with MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), -60000 ms, over (0, 64, 0) = word 1 bit 6 = Sated 532125 (DurationIndex 25 = 180000 ms, so it becomes 120000) and the helper 300796, which nothing applies. Player::ApplySpellMod consumes SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN and Aura::CalcMaxDuration consumes SPELLMOD_DURATION. Tooltip: "Reduces the cooldown of Fleshcraft and the duration of the Sated debuff by $/1000;s1 sec." Both spells the tooltip names are correctly selected. Regression guard for native behaviour.
